items.title: AI Debt Binge Hits a Wall As Global Bond Markets Reach Saturation Point, Wells Fargo Warns
items.summary: Wells Fargo warns that massive corporate borrowing to fund AI infrastructure is straining the $15 trillion investment-grade bond market, and investors are pushing back.

items.title: AI 'Supply Shock' Pushes Bond Market to Limit: O'Connor
items.summary: Maureen O'Connor, global head of high-grade debt syndicate at Wells Fargo, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss the record amount of issuance in the US high-grade market this year.

items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Up 6.1% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Wells Fargo (WFC) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: C Trades at a Discount to Industry: Right Time to Buy the Stock?
items.summary: Is Citigroup's discounted valuation, improving earnings outlook and ongoing business transformation making the stock an attractive buy? Let us find out.

items.title: BAC Reaffirms 16-18% ROTCE Target: Can Profitability Improve Further?
items.summary: Bank of America reaffirms its ROTCE target for 2028-2030 as rising net interest income, loan growth and expense discipline bolster its profitability outlook.

items.title: Two More Firms Downgraded DraftKings in One Day. Is the Selloff Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBerenberg cut DraftKings to Hold and Wells Fargo cut it to Equal Weight on Nov. 10, with targets of $20 and $21, after a third-quarter report that slashed the company’s 2026 profit outlook.

items.title: Wells Fargo whistleblower argues SEC played ‘fast and loose’
items.summary: Michael Bacon, a former Wells Fargo executive-turned-whistleblower, is appealing a decision by the Securities and Exchange Commission to slash the size of his award. His lawyer argues the agency had political motives.
